items.title: Desk market wrap 11/9
items.summary: Stocks bounced to start the week as oil dropped another 3% and eased inflation fears, though AI financing stayed an overhang. SPY and QQQ squeezed back to the 8-day average on a wide-range session; desk waits on this week's inflation data. A few large call books adjusted.

items.title: Desk open wrap 11/9
items.summary: Futures firmer to start the week as oil kept falling and metals bid; VIX dropped again. Europe recovered some of last week's losses and Nikkei bounced after last week's slide. CPI is next.

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/6
items.summary: Jobs print came in stronger and the dollar firmed; the AI complex faded after the open. NYAD stays in a sell signal, VIX held over 20, and SPY is trying to hold the rising 200-day into next week's inflation prints. Size put sellers were active in first-quarter 2027 in beaten-up quality names.

items.title: Desk open wrap 11/6
items.summary: Futures steadied after Thursday's plunge with jobs in focus; VIX still elevated after the spike. Tech led an early snapback while Europe and Asia sold off on AI-spend and valuation worries.
